title: Streaming Experiment Evidence
description: Minh chứng có thể tái tạo cho watermark, partition, rate, late ratio và checkpoint recovery. Mọi panel được cô lập theo experiment run và scenario.

list.name: experiment_run_id
list.label: Experiment run
list.query:
SELECT r.run_id::text AS __value, r.experiment_type || ' | ' || r.topic || ' | ' || r.status || ' | ' || to_char(r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text
FROM streaming.experiment_runs r
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM streaming.experiment_scenarios s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.ground_truth_status <> 'unavailable')
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC
list.definition: SELECT r.run_id::text AS __value, r.experiment_type || ' | ' || r.topic || ' | ' || r.status || ' | ' || to_char(r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS __text FROM streaming.experiment_runs r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM streaming.experiment_scenarios s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.ground_truth_status <> 'unavailable') ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

list.name: scenario_name
list.label: Scenario
list.query:
SELECT scenario_name AS __value, scenario_name AS __text
FROM streaming.experiment_scenarios
WHERE run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
ORDER BY sequence_number
list.definition: SELECT scenario_name AS __value, scenario_name AS __text FROM streaming.experiment_scenarios WHERE run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id' ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Count accuracy theo scenario
panels.description: Intersection/union giữa ground truth của event Kafka đã ACK và Spark actual. Missing và extra đều làm giảm điểm; NULL nghĩa là evidence chưa hoàn chỉnh.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name AS metric, overall_count_accuracy_percent AS value
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_accuracy
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Amount accuracy theo scenario
panels.description: So sánh tổng amount theo full set window/category; công thức đối xứng nên amount thừa cũng bị trừ điểm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name AS metric, overall_amount_accuracy_percent AS value
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_accuracy
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Missing / extra events
panels.description: Missing là event thuộc ground truth nhưng không có trong Spark output; extra là Spark output vượt ground truth.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name, total_missing_count AS missing, total_extra_count AS extra
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_accuracy
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Late events accepted / dropped
panels.description: Late accepted/dropped được suy ra từ ground truth và actual của cùng scenario, không dự đoán chỉ từ late_delay <= watermark.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name, total_late_events_accepted AS accepted, total_late_events_dropped AS dropped
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_accuracy
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Throughput theo scenario
panels.description: Target generator, tốc độ delivery thực tế và Spark processed rows/s trung bình trong đúng batch bounds của scenario.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name, target_rate_events_s AS target, delivered_rate_events_s AS delivered, ROUND(avg_processed_rows_per_second, 3) AS spark_processed
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: p95 end-to-end latency theo scenario
panels.description: Giá trị lớn nhất của p95 micro-batch trong scenario; đây không phải p95 gộp của toàn bộ event.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name AS metric, max_batch_p95_latency_ms AS value
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Consumer lag theo scenario
panels.description: Lag lớn nhất quan sát được trong đúng batch bounds của mỗi scenario.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name, max_total_consumer_lag AS total_lag, max_partition_lag AS max_partition_lag
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: p95 checkpoint commit theo scenario
panels.description: p95 của checkpoint commit time trên các micro-batch đo được trong scenario.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name AS metric, p95_checkpoint_commit_ms AS value
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Bảng so sánh scenario đầy đủ
panels.description: Một dòng cho mỗi scenario: biến kiểm soát, runtime metric, accuracy và trạng thái completeness.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.sequence_number, m.scenario_name, m.experiment_type, m.topic,
  m.partition_count, m.active_partitions, m.watermark_delay_seconds,
  m.target_rate_events_s, m.delivered_rate_events_s,
  ROUND(m.avg_processed_rows_per_second, 3) AS avg_processed_rows_per_second,
  m.max_total_consumer_lag, m.max_partition_lag,
  ROUND(m.max_batch_p95_latency_ms, 3) AS max_batch_p95_latency_ms,
  ROUND(m.p95_checkpoint_commit_ms::numeric, 3) AS p95_checkpoint_commit_ms,
  m.rows_dropped_by_watermark,
  a.total_expected_count, a.total_actual_count,
  a.total_missing_count, a.total_extra_count,
  a.overall_count_accuracy_percent, a.overall_amount_accuracy_percent,
  a.total_late_events_accepted, a.total_late_events_dropped,
  a.ground_truth_manifest_sha256, a.accuracy_complete,
  m.metrics_bounds_complete, m.spark_status, m.pipeline_effective_status,
  m.scenario_status
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics m
LEFT JOIN streaming.experiment_scenario_accuracy a
  ON a.experiment_run_id = m.experiment_run_id
 AND a.scenario_name = m.scenario_name
WHERE m.experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND m.scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY m.sequence_number

panels.title: Chi tiết accuracy theo window / category
panels.description: FULL OUTER JOIN: expected_present=false cho actual-only; actual_present=false cho missing window/category.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT scenario_name, topic, window_start, window_end, merchant_category,
  expected_present, actual_present, expected_count, actual_count,
  missing_count, extra_count, expected_amount, actual_amount,
  count_accuracy_percent, amount_accuracy_percent,
  expected_late_count, actual_late_count,
  late_events_accepted, late_events_dropped, late_events_extra,
  last_batch_id, manifest_sha256
FROM streaming.window_accuracy_results
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY scenario_name, window_start, merchant_category
LIMIT 2000

panels.title: Checkpoint và Spark run evidence
panels.description: Liên kết chính xác scenario với Spark run, checkpoint và khoảng batch dùng để tổng hợp metrics.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sequence_number, scenario_name, spark_run_id, spark_query_id,
  spark_checkpoint_location, spark_baseline_batch_id, spark_final_batch_id,
  metric_batch_count, p95_checkpoint_commit_ms, max_watermark_at,
  spark_status, pipeline_effective_status, metrics_bounds_complete
FROM streaming.experiment_scenario_metrics
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number

panels.title: Checkpoint restart verification
panels.description: Minh chứng dừng Spark, tạo backlog khi job đang dừng và khởi động lại cùng checkpoint: query_id giữ nguyên, spark_run_id thay đổi, offset phục hồi và accuracy xác nhận không mất/không trùng.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sequence_number, scenario_name,
  checkpoint_recovery_verified, no_loss_no_duplicates, accuracy_complete,
  query_id_preserved, spark_run_changed, checkpoint_reused, offsets_recovered,
  total_expected_count, total_actual_count, total_missing_count, total_extra_count,
  phase1_delivered, downtime_delivered, backlog_event_count, topic,
  before_spark_run_id, after_spark_run_id, before_query_id, after_query_id,
  checkpoint_location
FROM streaming.checkpoint_recovery_results
WHERE experiment_run_id::text = '$experiment_run_id'
  AND scenario_name IN ($scenario_name)
ORDER BY sequence_number
